Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the date format, converting “11 September 1962” (DD/MM) to “11/09/1962” and reading it as November 9, 1962 instead of September 11, 1962. This day/month swap (date normalization error) introduced an incorrect birth date despite sources clearly indicating 11 September 1962.
